_comment: Hasher fixtures: hash_mac layout preservation and correlation across layouts.

hash_mac_format_cases._comment: hash_mac keeps the input's layout: separator and grouping survive, the first octet becomes the locally administered 02, hex is lowercase. A value in no MAC layout gets the colon form.

hash_mac_normalization_cases._comment: Every layout of one MAC hashes to the same digits, so correlation survives a device writing the same MAC two ways. Separators and case are not part of the identity.
